messages:
maria: Quick check — we finished the Sable9B bring-up and quant bakeoff. Need a concise recommendation for GTN: int8 default or keep fp16? short rationale pls.
ajay: Raw numbers from the sweep (small-sample QA + chat slices). fp16 baseline QA@1=0.872, int8=0.867 (-0.005), int6=0.840 (-0.032). p50 latency: fp16=85ms, int8=72ms, int6=59ms. cost/1M tokens: fp16=$120, int8=$78, int6=$55.
lina: Quality notes: int8 shows tiny degradation on long-context retrieval prompts (drop concentrated in >1024 tokens). int6 has systematic drop on multi-step reasoning and some hallucination increase (~+4% halluc rate on our slice).
sam: Perf was consistent across hosts. Bench snippet: ```bash
# perf sample (p50 tokens/sec)
fp16: 11.8k tps
int8: 14.1k tps
int6: 17.2k tps
```
zoe: From product/GTN POV we care about user-visible regressions on high-revenue intents (billing, purchase flow, policy). Those must be near-zero. For general chat we can tolerate tiny dips.
maria: Proposal: default route => sable9b-int8 with prefix caching and tuned beam settings; canary high-value intents on fp16. fallback to fp16 for any eval signal regressions. Also publish a short playbook for support.
ajay: Agree. Add guardrail: run prompt-set evaluation on deploy; if QA@1 drop >0.01 vs baseline for the specific slice, auto-fail to fp16. Also suggest hybrid scoring: small sample A/B 5% traffic to fp16 for first 24h.
nate: Operational note — int8 instances showed 12% lower memory pressure on GPUs which helps packing; autoscaler rules need max_surge still with fp16 fallback.
deploy-bot: benchmark run 3751234567 finished — artifact: sable9b-int8-sweep-3751234567.tar.gz (s3://bench/artifacts/3751234567) :white_check_mark: 
lina: One more: recommend we keep int6 behind rerank-only and only for low-accuracy candidate generation; require manual QA signoff before any public routing.
zoe: TL;DR for GTN: "Use sable9b-int8 as default — ~35% cost reduction vs fp16 with negligible quality loss on primary slices. Route high-value intents to fp16 for first 48h and keep int6 limited to non-critical rerank paths."
maria: Action items: 1) ajay -> add deploy gate eval (due EOD). 2) sam -> add fallback routing config and autoscaler tweak (tomorrow). 3) lina -> assemble 200-sample QA prompt set for product slices (48h). 4) zoe -> short GTN note + rollout instructions (start now).
ajay: I'll drop the eval job and metric thresholds in the deploy CI. snippet for gate config: ```json
{"gate":{"metric":"qa@1","delta_threshold":-0.01,"window":"1h","fail_action":"fallback_fp16"}}
```
maria: Perfect. If nobody objects I'll publish the recommendation in the GTN ticket and start the canary tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
